query: How do I initialize my workspace domain and generate API keys?
groundTruthAnswer: Click Create Organization, pick a unique domain slug, then go to Settings > API Access Keys to generate secret tokens.

query: What HTTP header must be passed for API authentication?
groundTruthAnswer: Pass your key as a Bearer token in the Authorization header: Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>.

query: What happens when rate limits are exceeded?
groundTruthAnswer: The API responds with HTTP 429 Too Many Requests containing a retry_after_seconds field.

query: What are the SAML ACS URL and Entity ID for Okta SSO?
groundTruthAnswer: ACS URL is https://auth.novabase.io/saml/acs and Entity ID is urn:novabase:sp:auth.

query: How are mid-cycle user seats billed?
groundTruthAnswer: Mid-cycle seat additions incur a prorated charge, while removed seats apply account credit.

query: How do I verify webhook payloads from NovaBase?
groundTruthAnswer: Verify the HMAC SHA-256 signature passed in the X-Nova-Signature header against your secret.

query: How do I resolve CORS origin blocked errors?
groundTruthAnswer: Add your domain in Admin > Portal Settings > Allowed Widget Domains including protocol scheme.

query: What role permissions are available for workspace members?
groundTruthAnswer: Admin (full control), Editor (can publish and edit), and Viewer (read-only access).

query: What is the Pro plan request rate limit?
groundTruthAnswer: 600 requests per minute with a burst allowance of 50 req/sec.

query: Where can past invoice PDFs be downloaded?
groundTruthAnswer: Navigate to Admin > Billing > Invoice History and click Download PDF.
